cases.description: Exact Boolean union of the procedural 55928 stand-in (open tube wound inside a ball) with its rotated, shifted copy, default knot options (benchmarks/BooleanComparison/README.md, tail case knot).
Same stand-in with a denser tube (more rings, more turns): more self-intersecting pairs per triangle.
Thingi10K 55928 (the open, self-intersecting knot, docs/design/EXACT_BOOLEAN_TAIL_55928.md) with its rotated, shifted copy (BooleanComparison export), union. Fetched at run time.

Alpha Wrap (MeshAlphaWrap, MeshRepairBenchmark BENCH_REPAIR=wrap, library defaults) of the procedural knot: an open tube wound tightly inside a ball, self-intersecting, many small triangles in every direction.
Alpha Wrap of the denser knot (more rings and turns).
